low_end.description: Sub bass weight, kick character, and low-end movement

artists.name: ChaseWest

groove.notes: Swung hi-hats with a bouncy, body-moving groove. Keeps things rolling without being overly complex.

percussion_density.notes: Clean and punchy rather than busy. Relies on well-placed claps and shakers to drive the rhythm.

low_end.notes: Strong sub-bass presence with a rounded, punchy kick. Low-end is felt more than heard.

arrangement.notes: Straightforward DJ-friendly structures. Clear intros, builds, and drops. Breakdowns are short and functional.

tension.notes: Uses risers and filter sweeps for build-ups. Drops hit hard with bass re-entry.

vocal_usage.notes: Frequently uses chopped vocal hooks and spoken-word samples. Vocals are central to the identity of tracks.

energy_profile.notes: Peak-time energy with a fun, accessible vibe. Designed for big-room moments.

artists.summary: Accessible peak-time tech house with vocal hooks, bouncy grooves, and strong low-end.

artists.name: Michael Bibi

groove.notes: Heavy shuffle and swing. Grooves are hypnotic and relentless, built around off-beat percussion.

percussion_density.notes: Layered percussion with congas, bongos, and shakers creating a busy but controlled rhythmic bed.

low_end.notes: Dark, driving kick with deep sub presence. Low-end is tight and punchy, tailored for big systems.

arrangement.notes: Loop-driven structures with subtle element additions. Builds are gradual rather than dramatic.

tension.notes: Tension comes from percussion layering and filter work rather than big risers. Subtle but effective.

vocal_usage.notes: Uses vocal chops and spoken-word snippets as rhythmic elements rather than melodic hooks.

energy_profile.notes: Dark, driving energy. Peak-time but with an underground edge. Works in both clubs and festivals.

artists.summary: Dark, percussion-heavy tech house with hypnotic grooves and underground energy.

artists.name: PAWSA

groove.notes: Master of groove. Swung, funky rhythms that lock in and don't let go. Heavily influenced by classic house.

percussion_density.notes: Selective but impactful percussion. Every element has purpose. Not cluttered.

low_end.notes: Warm, round bass that moves and grooves. Not overly heavy — serves the rhythm rather than dominating.

arrangement.notes: Smooth, DJ-tool-friendly structures. Gradual layering with satisfying payoffs.

tension.notes: Tension is subtle. Relies on groove hypnosis rather than dramatic builds or drops.

vocal_usage.notes: Often uses soulful vocal samples and chops. Vocals sit in the groove and add character.

energy_profile.notes: Mid-energy groover. Perfect for warming up a room or maintaining a locked-in dance floor.

artists.summary: Groove-first tech house with funk influences, soulful vocals, and understated builds.

artists.name: Void

groove.notes: Tight, driving groove with less swing and more forward momentum. Mechanical but musical.

percussion_density.notes: Layered rhythmic textures with metallic and synthetic percussion. Detailed and intricate.

low_end.notes: Heavy, processed kick with sub-bass rumble. Low-end is dark and industrial-leaning.

arrangement.notes: Hypnotic loop-based structures. Changes are subtle — elements fade in and out rather than hard-cutting.

tension.notes: Tension through texture and atmosphere. Uses reverb tails, noise sweeps, and subtle modulation.

vocal_usage.notes: Minimal vocal usage. Occasional distorted or processed vocal textures rather than clear vocals.

energy_profile.notes: Dark, intense energy for late-night sets. Relentless without being abrasive.

artists.summary: Dark, minimal tech house with intricate percussion, heavy low-end, and atmospheric tension.

artists.name: Zulan

groove.notes: Deep, rolling groove with subtle swing. Rhythms are warm and inviting, pulling listeners in.

percussion_density.notes: Balanced percussion. Clean hats and shakers with organic-sounding elements.

low_end.notes: Warm sub-bass with smooth movement. Low-end supports the groove without overwhelming it.

arrangement.notes: Well-structured with clear progression. Builds feel natural and unforced.

tension.notes: Gentle tension curves. Relies on harmonic movement and filter work rather than dramatic builds.

vocal_usage.notes: Uses vocal samples tastefully — chopped phrases and atmospheric vocal textures.

energy_profile.notes: Mid-energy deep groover. Suited for opening sets and intimate club moments.

artists.summary: Deep, warm tech house with rolling grooves, tasteful vocals, and smooth energy curves.

artists.name: Prospa

groove.notes: Energetic and forward-driving. Less swung, more four-to-the-floor with rave energy.

percussion_density.notes: Clean and punchy percussion. Not overly layered — lets synths and melodies take center stage.

low_end.notes: Solid kick foundation with controlled sub. Low-end is functional and supportive.

arrangement.notes: Dynamic arrangements with euphoric builds, breakdowns, and drops. More song-like than loop-based.

tension.notes: Big, euphoric builds with classic rave tension. Breakdowns strip back to melodic pads before explosive drops.

vocal_usage.notes: Prominent vocal hooks and pads. Often uses pitched vocals and vocal chords for euphoria.

energy_profile.notes: High-energy, euphoric, festival-ready. Crossover appeal between house and rave.

artists.summary: Euphoric rave-house crossover with big melodic builds, vocal hooks, and festival energy.

artists.name: Luke Dean

groove.notes: Funky, bouncy grooves with a classic house feel. Shuffle in the hats drives the rhythm.

percussion_density.notes: Well-curated percussion. Clean layers that complement rather than overwhelm.

low_end.notes: Tight kick with a musical bassline. Bass often carries melodic content.

arrangement.notes: DJ-friendly structures with smooth transitions between sections. Functional but musical.

tension.notes: Moderate tension through filter sweeps and percussion builds. Satisfying without being over-the-top.

vocal_usage.notes: Uses vocal cuts and samples as rhythmic hooks. Vocals add flavor without dominating.

energy_profile.notes: Versatile mid-energy. Works across warm-up and peak-time depending on the track.

artists.summary: Funky, well-crafted tech house with bouncy grooves and versatile energy.

artists.name: OMAR+

groove.notes: Deeply swung and hypnotic. Grooves are minimalist but irresistible — less is more approach.

percussion_density.notes: Sparse, intentional percussion. Every hit has maximum impact because of space around it.

low_end.notes: Warm, round bass that grooves rather than pounds. Musical low-end movement.

arrangement.notes: Minimal loop-based structures. Subtle element additions create movement over time.

tension.notes: Almost no overt tension. The groove itself is the hook — hypnotic repetition creates its own release.

vocal_usage.notes: Short, chopped vocal phrases used as rhythmic elements. Soulful and minimal.

energy_profile.notes: Deep, hypnotic energy. Best for late-night, intimate dance floors where groove takes priority.

artists.summary: Minimalist, groove-heavy tech house with hypnotic repetition and deep energy.

artists.name: Bontan

groove.notes: Funky and dance-floor-focused. Strong shuffle with a feel-good rhythmic base.

percussion_density.notes: Clean and bouncy percussion. Focused on groove rather than complexity.

low_end.notes: Rounded, musical basslines. Low-end has character and movement.

arrangement.notes: Well-structured with satisfying builds and payoffs. DJ-tool friendly.

tension.notes: Moderate tension using percussion drops and filter sweeps. Builds feel natural.

vocal_usage.notes: Vocal-forward productions. Often uses full vocal hooks and soulful samples.

energy_profile.notes: Feel-good, mid-to-high energy. Great for setting a fun, upbeat mood.

artists.summary: Feel-good, vocal-driven tech house with funky grooves and accessible energy.

artists.name: Adam Ten

groove.notes: Deep, rolling grooves with afro-influenced rhythmic patterns. Organic and earthy feel.

percussion_density.notes: Rich, layered organic percussion. Congas, shakers, and tribal elements create depth.

low_end.notes: Warm, deep bass that evolves slowly. Not aggressive — supportive and musical.

arrangement.notes: Journey-like arrangements with long builds and evolving textures. More epic than loop-based.

tension.notes: Tension through layering and harmonic progression. Builds are patient and rewarding.

vocal_usage.notes: Ethnic vocal samples and chants. Vocals add atmosphere and cultural texture.

energy_profile.notes: Mid-energy with emotional depth. Suited for sunset sets and melodic journey moments.

artists.summary: Melodic, percussion-rich deep house with afro influences and journey-like arrangements.

artists.name: Mita Gami

groove.notes: Tight, bouncy grooves with a modern tech house shuffle. Dance-floor-focused rhythms.

percussion_density.notes: Clean, punchy percussion that supports the groove. Well-mixed and defined.

low_end.notes: Solid kick-bass relationship. Low-end is functional and clean.

arrangement.notes: Effective, DJ-friendly structures with clear energy arcs.

tension.notes: Standard build-and-drop tension. Uses risers and percussion lifts effectively.

vocal_usage.notes: Strong vocal presence with catchy hooks and chopped phrases. Vocals carry the track identity.

energy_profile.notes: Upbeat, accessible energy. Works well in both clubs and festivals.

artists.summary: Vocal-driven tech house with catchy hooks, clean production, and upbeat energy.

artists.name: Odd Mob

groove.notes: Driving and energetic. Less swing, more punch. Grooves are designed for maximum impact.

percussion_density.notes: Punchy and direct. Percussion serves the drops rather than creating intricate patterns.

low_end.notes: Massive bass presence. Heavy, distorted bass drops are a signature element. Sub-shaking low-end.

arrangement.notes: Dynamic song structures with big breakdowns and heavy drops. More bass-music-influenced arrangements.

tension.notes: Extreme tension-release cycles. Big builds into heavy bass drops. Designed for crowd reaction.

vocal_usage.notes: Uses vocal samples and chops in builds. Vocals serve the energy arc rather than being melodic hooks.

energy_profile.notes: Maximum energy. Festival-ready, peak-time, crowd-moving productions.

artists.summary: High-energy bass house with massive drops, extreme tension-release, and festival-ready productions.

artists.name: Rafael

groove.notes: Smooth, rolling groove with a Latin-influenced bounce. Rhythms are warm and inviting.

percussion_density.notes: Tasteful percussion with organic textures. Congas and rim shots add flavor.

low_end.notes: Musical basslines with groove and movement. Bass is a lead instrument.

arrangement.notes: Smooth progressions with well-timed element introductions. DJ-friendly.

tension.notes: Subtle tension through percussion builds and bassline modulation. No dramatic drops.

vocal_usage.notes: Uses chopped vocal phrases and snippets as rhythmic tools. Adds character without dominating.

energy_profile.notes: Mid-energy groover. Perfect for dance floor warm-ups and maintaining flow.

artists.summary: Groovy, Latin-influenced tech house with musical basslines and smooth, flowing energy.

artists.name: Brunello

groove.notes: Gentle, rolling groove. More hypnotic than bouncy. Organic and natural-feeling rhythms.

percussion_density.notes: Organic percussion with natural timbres. Wooden and earthy sounds create warmth.

low_end.notes: Deep, warm bass that breathes. Low-end is supportive and unobtrusive.

arrangement.notes: Evolving, journey-style arrangements. Tracks develop slowly with patience and intention.

tension.notes: Minimal tension. Builds are gradual and atmospheric. No hard drops.

vocal_usage.notes: Sparse vocal use. Occasional ethereal vocal textures or distant chants.

energy_profile.notes: Low-energy, deep and meditative. Best for opening sets and intimate listening moments.

artists.summary: Deep, organic house with patient arrangements, warm textures, and meditative energy.

artists.name: Yamagucci

groove.notes: Bouncy, high-energy groove with a modern tech house shuffle. Infectious and physical.

percussion_density.notes: Punchy percussion that complements heavy bass. Clean and impactful.

low_end.notes: Heavy, distorted bass elements. Low-end is aggressive and attention-grabbing.

arrangement.notes: Effective build-drop structures. Clear energy arcs designed for dance floor impact.

tension.notes: Strong tension-release with filtered builds and bass drops. Energy shifts are dramatic.

vocal_usage.notes: Vocal chops and samples used as hooks and rhythmic elements.

energy_profile.notes: High-energy, bass-forward tech house. Designed for peak-time moments.

artists.summary: Bass-heavy tech house with bouncy grooves, aggressive low-end, and peak-time energy.

artists.name: Keinemusik

groove.notes: Deeply musical grooves blending afro, deep house, and electronic textures. Hypnotic and layered.

percussion_density.notes: Rich, organic percussion. Afro-influenced drums, shakers, and hand percussion create a full rhythmic tapestry.

low_end.notes: Warm, deep bass that flows. Not heavy-handed — supports the groove elegantly.

arrangement.notes: Sophisticated, journey-like arrangements. Tracks unfold over time with multiple movements and emotional arcs.

tension.notes: Tension through harmonic and textural evolution. Patient builds that reward attentive listening.

vocal_usage.notes: Prominent use of ethnic and soulful vocals. Vocals are integral to the emotional narrative.

energy_profile.notes: Mid-energy with emotional depth. Creates transcendent dance floor moments through musicality.

artists.summary: Musically sophisticated collective blending afro, deep, and melodic house with rich arrangements and emotional depth.

artists.name: Giaggi

groove.notes: Tight, rolling groove with a minimal influence. Clean and hypnotic rhythmic patterns.

percussion_density.notes: Precise, well-placed percussion. Minimal approach — every hit counts.

low_end.notes: Clean, defined low-end. Kick and bass have clear separation and purpose.

arrangement.notes: Functional, loop-based structures with subtle development. DJ-tool oriented.

tension.notes: Understated tension. Relies on groove and subtle modulation rather than builds.

vocal_usage.notes: Minimal vocal use. Occasional short samples or processed vocal textures.

energy_profile.notes: Steady, consistent energy. Great for keeping a dance floor locked in.

artists.summary: Clean, minimal tech house with precise grooves and steady, hypnotic energy.

artists.name: KinAhau

percussion_density.notes: Dense organic percussion layers. Tribal drums, djembes, and hand percussion create a ritualistic feel.

low_end.notes: Warm, earthy bass. Low-end is deep but not heavy — complements the organic palette.

arrangement.notes: Evolving, ceremonial arrangements. Tracks build like rituals — slowly adding layers of energy.

tension.notes: Tension through percussion builds and vocal incantations. Builds feel spiritual.

vocal_usage.notes: Ethnic vocals, chants, and ceremonial singing. Vocals are a core element of the sound identity.

energy_profile.notes: Mid-energy with spiritual intensity. Creates trance-like dance floor states.

artists.name: Djibouti

groove.notes: Afro-influenced groove with modern tech house production. Polyrhythmic elements create complexity.

percussion_density.notes: Rich percussion layers blending electronic and organic drums. Busy but musical.

low_end.notes: Solid, defined low-end that supports complex rhythmic patterns above.

arrangement.notes: Effective structures that balance loop-based hypnosis with build-and-release moments.

tension.notes: Tension through percussion layering and rhythmic intensity. Builds feel organic.

vocal_usage.notes: Vocal chants and afro-influenced vocal samples add cultural texture.

energy_profile.notes: Energetic and driving. Afro rhythms create a physical, body-moving experience.

artists.summary: Afro-tech house fusion with polyrhythmic percussion, cultural textures, and driving energy.

artists.name: Alex Yav

groove.notes: Smooth, deep groove with a warm shuffle. Rhythms are inviting and easy to lock into.

percussion_density.notes: Clean, well-mixed percussion. Balanced layers that support the groove.

low_end.notes: Warm, round bass with musical movement. Low-end has character without being heavy.

arrangement.notes: Well-structured, DJ-friendly arrangements. Clear progressions with satisfying payoffs.

tension.notes: Gentle tension through filter work and element addition. No dramatic builds.

vocal_usage.notes: Tasteful vocal samples and chops that complement the groove. Not overpowering.

energy_profile.notes: Mid-energy, versatile output. Smooth and controlled — good for various set positions.
